lines.text: Many learners say: I went to a gas stand.
Better: I went to a gas station.
Say gas station in American English.
Station! We need a gas station.

data.wrong: I went to a gas stand.
data.right: I went to a gas station.
data.why: Say gas station in American English.
data.memory: I went to a gas station.

native.hook: 「ガソリンスタンド」は和製英語って知ってた？
native.tip: stand は英語では「屋台」のようなイメージ。ガソリンスタンドは gas station と言う。
native.caption: “I went to a gas stand.”と言っていませんか？😅 「ガソリンスタンド」は和製英語で、英語では gas station です。“I went to a gas station.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“station”。gas station が正しい言い方。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Use gas station. Gas stand is Japanese-English.
en.caption: Do you say “I went to a gas stand.”? 😅 Gas stand is a Japanese-made English word. In American English, say gas station. The natural way is “I went to a gas station.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
